comment: steal.c steal() 385-390: a debug Valkyrie reads a wished cursed scroll of punishment, buries the ball with #wizbury (u.utrap becomes TT_BURIEDBALL and she is no longer Punished), takes off her shield and drops everything (D, all types), so she carries nothing a nymph can take. She wakes a nymph created next to her (^G) with F and waits; on the 1-in-4 roll the nymph 'takes off your unseen chain' and openholdingtrap() frees her from the buried ball (seed from a port scan of 5540101-5540140).
